note: Оригинальные учебные материалы. Последовательность тем выровнена по типичному маршруту Elementary A1→A2; тексты, задания и объяснения написаны заново.
format: Урок 30–40 минут: warm-up → 12 слов → правило → controlled practice → reading → listening (TTS) → speaking → writing → review.

lessons.title: Hello, my name is…
lessons.goal: Представиться, спросить имя/страну и назвать число.
lessons.rule: be согласуется с местоимением: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are.

reading.title: Hello, my name is…: short text
reading.text: Maya lives in a small town. This lesson is about names, countries, numbers. In the morning she meets a new student and asks simple questions. Every day Maya uses words like boil, fry and bake. The rule is simple: be согласуется с местоимением: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. At the end of the day Maya writes three sentences and says them aloud.

listening.script: Hi, I’m Maya. Today I want to talk about names, countries, numbers. I say my name slowly and spell the difficult surname. First I learn the words, then I read a short text. My favourite word today is add. Now I can answer questions and speak for one minute.
